gameDescriptionHtml:
Team up with friends and run your own storage! Receive, store and ship items to make a profit. Handle everything from boxes to hazardous goods. Design and expand your warehouse, manage costs, power and workers.

Game Features

  • STORAGE – Your job is to receive items at the input ports, sort and organize them in your warehouse, and ship them out through the correct output ports. Every successful shipment makes you money! Each item is labeled with an output region, so you’ll need to sort and ship them to the matching output ports. But watch out for expiration dates, you need to send items out before they expire!
  • ITEMS AND COMPOUNDS – Manage a wide variety of incoming items, each with its own storage needs. Some require extra care, while others are easier to handle. Use specialized storage rooms called compounds to handle items with specific storing requirements, such as Freezer, Hazard, and UV compounds.
  • MANAGEMENT – Hire and manage AI workers to assist with item handling, boosting productivity and automating your storage workflow. Manage the power room and ensure you have enough fuel for the engines to keep your storage running. Access the Storage Terminal to track and manage your storage costs, you’re in control of the budget. Inspections occur at random times, so keep everything in order and avoid any suspicious activity!
  • CUSTOMIZATION – Access the Shop through the Storage Terminal to purchase Shelves, Compounds, Equipment, and Decorations for your storage. As you earn money, you can expand your storage space, allowing you to grow your business and store more items. Customize your storage to enhance functionality and improve its look. Use different shelves, add compounds and equipment, and decorate to make your storage unique and attractive.
